data.standardized_narrative: The report discloses the syndicate's gross claims outstanding on the balance sheet and includes a claims development table. The gross claims outstanding (technical provisions - claims outstanding) at the start of the year (opening reserves at 1 Jan 2017) is reported in the prior-year column of the balance sheet. The notes and claims development table show a mix of favourable and adverse movements across older underwriting years, driven by large-loss development, case reserve movement and IBNR recalibration; however a single explicit gross prior-year development amount (total) was not clearly extractable from the available images. Users should verify the precise prior-year movement from the full PDF.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction performed from scanned/rotated page images. Key numeric fields (opening reserves and the claims development/triangle) are partially legible; the balance-sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year (2016) value was read as GBP 1,394.7m but the scanned images are low resolution and some table cells/labels are ambiguous. The report contains a full gross claims development table (page ~31) but the development-period diagonal values required to calculate a definitive gross 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' were not unambiguously readable in the provided images, so prior_year_development is returned as null. Gross premium total inferred from the Technical Account table (visible) but segmental breakdown rows were not reliably extractable. Recommend manual verification against the original PDF.
